purpose: Teach: 現像/楽屋/田園/器官/武蔵野/生理学/緑地/合体

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがフィルムの現像をされたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he did his own film developing.
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic opening. Voice settles into memory. Steady pace, gentle conviction — not performing the past, simply holding it. Slight warmth under the distance of years.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、芝居の楽屋を訪ねられたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and you used to visit the theatre backstage, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Bright recognition. Gentle teasing lilt at the end — she's reminding him of something he loved. Warm, slightly mischievous. The rhythm of an old affectionate correction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは田園詩を好まれた
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, my father had a love for pastoral poetry.
lines.style: Voice drifts slightly inward. Contemplative, almost tender. Slower pace on the middle phrase. The quality of someone remembering what mattered to someone he loved.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お孫様に器官の名前を教えてらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you taught the grandchildren the names of all those organs, didn't you, love?
lines.style: Affectionate, slightly conspiratorial tone. A little knowing — she's gently steering him toward pride in what he passed on. Light, conversational rhythm with warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんと武蔵野の森を歩いた
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, I walked through the Musashino forest with my father.
lines.style: Voice drops slightly, almost intimate. The memory has weight. Steady, unhurried pace. A pause before 'forest' — letting the place settle into the room. Breathing room between past and present.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、生理学を学ばれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you studied physiology when you were young, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Warm, slightly wondering tone. She's following the thread of his life with gentle attention. Natural rhythm, no rush. Pride hiding under tenderness. The comfort of knowing someone completely.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、地元の緑地で結婚式を挙げたぞ
lines.en: Gran, we had our wedding in that green space near our home, remember?
lines.style: Voice lifts slightly — warmth breaking through. Direct, almost tender. The 'remember' is not a question but an invitation to stand together in the moment. Calm certainty underneath.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、新旧の伝統を合体させた行事を企画されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you always mixed the old traditions with new ones for every celebration, didn't you?
lines.style: Voice softens at the edges. Genuine delight — she's circling back to the fullness of him. Slow, appreciative pace. A trailing warmth, like she's still learning how to say what he means to her.
